defects_repaired.c011_behaviour: c011_trainer_state.py saved np.random.get_state() (the legacy GLOBAL RNG) and re-seeded with np.random.seed(); the trainer sampled from a separate np.random.default_rng(seed) object, so restore restored nothing it used.
defects_repaired.c012_repair: One Generator drives opponent draws, seats, per-game seeds and the PPO minibatch permutation, saved/restored via rng.bit_generator.state.
defects_repaired.evidence: tests/test_c012_rng_restore.py (7 tests incl. a test that the legacy global state cannot reproduce a default_rng stream)

defects_repaired.c011_behaviour: c011's continuation test passed precomputed minibatch permutations to both runs, which masks exactly the RNG divergence the test should detect.
defects_repaired.c012_repair: Permutations are drawn from the live Generator inside the update; the test compares opponent draws, seats, requested seeds, permutations, losses and parameters across a save/restore boundary, and includes a NEGATIVE CONTROL proving a broken restore would be caught.

defects_repaired.c011_behaviour: games_done counted only games with trainable decisions, excluding completed games that contained only forced decisions.
defects_repaired.c012_repair: completed_games is the budget quantity; completed_games, games_with_trainable_decisions and trainable_decisions are tracked separately in every summary and update record.

defects_repaired.c011_behaviour: all evaluation ran after training finished, so the registered stop rules had no data during the run.
defects_repaired.c012_repair: Registered evaluations run DURING training at every registered point and feed the stop rules.
defects_repaired.residual_defect: A path-keyed hash cache made those in-run evaluations return no scored games after game 0 in the executed run; see failures/DEFECT_inrun_evaluation_stale_hash.md. The mechanism is implemented and fixed, but was NOT exercised by this run's P1 arm.

defects_repaired.c011_behaviour: c011's scale decision took the MAXIMUM bootstrap significance across any seed/metric pair as its 'one median improvement' condition.
defects_repaired.c012_repair: c012 computes the registered MEDIAN best-per-seed improvement for both teacher and field, and reports the medians explicitly in curriculum_decision.json.
